import json
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
from part2.capital_flow import runner
from part2.capital_flow.contracts import FlowObservation
from part2.capital_flow.storage import load_observations

def test_failed_publish_retry_is_coherent_and_idempotent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    old, new = 1800000000000, 1800000060000
    local = tmp_path / "local"
    runner.run_once(local_dir=local, network=False, external_jsonl=(), as_of_ms=old)
    row = FlowObservation(family="etf", metric="net_flow_usd", asset="BTC",
                          value=123.0, unit="USD", effective_at_ms=old,
                          available_at_ms=old, observed_at_ms=old,
                          source="offline_fixture", source_record_id="r1")
    source = tmp_path / "source.jsonl"
    source.write_text(json.dumps(row.to_dict()) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    original = runner.atomic_write_json
    def fail_audit(path, payload):
        if Path(path).name == "audit_latest.json":
            raise OSError("injected audit publish failure")
        return original(path, payload)
    names = ("latest.json", "audit_latest.json", "anata_latest.json")
    def stamps():
        return [json.loads((local / name).read_text())["as_of_ms"] for name in names]
    with monkeypatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(runner, "atomic_write_json", fail_audit)
        with pytest.raises(OSError, match="injected audit publish failure"):
            runner.run_once(local_dir=local, network=False,
                            external_jsonl=(source,), as_of_ms=new)
    after_failure = stamps()
    assert len(load_observations(local / "observations.jsonl")) == 1
    retried = runner.run_once(local_dir=local, network=False,
                              external_jsonl=(source,), as_of_ms=new)
    assert retried["appended_observations"] == 0
    assert len(load_observations(local / "observations.jsonl")) == 1
    assert stamps() == [new, new, new]
    assert after_failure == [old, old, old], after_failure
